programme.title: Окно жизни
programme.desc: Славик и Надежда оказываются жертвами квартирных аферистов, поэтому после рождения второго ребёнка они вынуждены жить с семьёй Славика. Его сестра Алёна недовольна таким соседством. Славик уезжает на заработки. Пользуясь тем, что Славик в коме, Алёна выгоняет Надежду с детьми из квартиры. После длительных скитаний Надежда оставляет младенца в бэби-боксе. Соколова и Борадзе предлагают Глаше уволиться по собственному желанию. Борадзе сообщает коллективу о том, что подкидыша усыновила семья Нескоромовых. Коллектив перинатального центра прощается с Милославской - сердце коллеги остановилось. Славик выходит из комы, Алёна признается ему в своем вранье.

programme.title: Доктор Надежда
programme.desc: Главные герои – неотразимый доктор Родионов и роковая красотка Ольга Ольховская поженились и ждут ребенка, обаятельная Карина влюблена, неунывающие Вита Игоревна и Лев Борисович, как всегда, на посту, а карьерист Игорь Гордеев вынашивает очередной бизнес-план – в следующем сезоне хочет открыть многопрофильную клинику… Зрители снова встретятся с любимыми героями прошлого сезона – Александром Родионовым, Игорем Гордеевым, Кариной, Ритой Андреевной, неунывающими Квитко, а также познакомятся с новыми врачами – Надеждой Павловой, Андреем Смирновым, Алексеем Стрелецким и другими героями. Одной из основных линий нового сезона станет история нового врача клиники Надежды Павловой, талантливого хирурга с неустроенной личной жизнью. Героине предстоит пройти сложный путь, обрести уверенность в себе, раскрыть свой талант, заслужить прощение дочери и встретить настоящую любовь. Кто из наших любимых героев будет приглашен на новое место работы, а кто по-прежнему останется в клинике репродуктологии? Какое отделение больницы окажется в центре сюжета? Будем ли мы наблюдать, как молодые родители Оля и Саша наслаждаются семейной идиллией, или появление ребенка станет для них тяжелым испытанием? Да и вообще, можно ли будет вновь записаться на прием к доктору Родионову? Или властный Игорь Ильич пригласит других специалистов, и они выйдут на первый план? И кто станет настоящим мужчиной мечты прекрасной Надежды Павловой?

programme.title: Крепостная
programme.desc: Юная сирота Катерина Вербицкая — очень красивая, умная и образованная девушка. Благодаря ее крестной матери Катю воспитали как барышню благородных кровей. Она знает иностранные языки, играет на фортепиано, рисует и прекрасно понимает, что все это никак не облегчит судьбу рожденной в неволе. Катерина принадлежит самым богатым помещикам в Нежине — Червинским. Девушка существует между двумя мирами — миром крепостных и дворян. И ни в одном из них для нее нет места. Жизнь приготовила Катерине немало сюрпризов. В борьбе за свое счастье ей придется пережить смерти близких, спастись от преследований маньяка, выбраться из мира киевских борделей. И главное — победить свою хозяйку, жестокую помещицу, которая хочет убить ее. Крепостная пройдет сквозь ад и встретится с ужасными испытаниями судьбы. Что же ее ждет в конце жесткой борьбы за право быть свободной и любимой?

programme.title: Страх в твоем доме
programme.desc: Боль и страдания, которые причиняют самые близкие люди, невыносимы. Дом из крепости становится тюрьмой. И в поисках выхода людям приходится идти на самые невероятные поступки. Ни один сценарист не сможет придумать такие сюжетные ходы, которые порой закручивает сама жизнь. В социальной докудраме "Страх в твоем доме" - только реальные истории, случившиеся с реальными людьми. Мы реконструируем события, основываясь на откровенных рассказах их участников, а наши эксперты - юристы и психологи - комментируют их и помогают найти выход из сложных, порой тупиковых ситуаций.

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Короткое слово нет
programme.desc: Жека вместе с товарищами похищает марку Корнеевых, устраивая целую инсценировку: один из них притворяется вором, а остальные — полицейскими, которые задерживают "преступника" и забирают марку на экспертизу. Узнав о цене марки, Седой заподозрил Жеку в обмане. Сам же Жека не знает настоящей стоимости реликвии, но хочет произвести впечатление на отца Таты, вернув марку. Между Жекой и Татой искренняя любовь, и девушка ему доверяет, хотя её брат Николай предупреждает её, что Жека — не тот, за кого себя выдаёт.

programme.title: Короткое слово нет
programme.desc: За Жекой наблюдает полицейский — брат Таты. Жека должен выполнить последнее незаконное задание, а потом начать жить честно. Полиция ведет слежку за Якубом, который торгует крадеными бриллиантами. Эти драгоценности должны быть украдены Жекой и его сообщниками. Когда жена приносит бриллианты Седому, он в ответ возвращает ему марку Корнеевых.

programme.title: Короткое слово нет
programme.desc: Жека и Тата наслаждаются временем вместе, и Жека обещает ей найти настоящую семейную марку. Никита пытается восстановить отношения с Татой, но она его отвергает. Николай начинает подозревать, что Жека замешан в мошенничестве в бизнес-центре, ограблении квартиры Таты и контрабанде бриллиантов, но Тата не верит этим предположениям. Жека возвращает марку, однако она оказывается подделкой. Корнеев прогоняет Жеку, а Тата ссорится с ним, осознав, что Жека её обманывал.

programme.title: Короткое слово нет
programme.desc: Жеку сбила машина, и он оказался в больнице, где его палату охраняет полиция. Тату не пускают к нему, но она понимает, что готова простить Жеку и быть рядом с ним. Николай советует сестре забыть Жеку. Тем временем Жека сбегает из больницы, спрыгнув с четвертого этажа. Он приходит к Марине и осознает, что Седой всех обманул. Марина помогает Жеке и Тате встретиться. Вместе они убегают от полиции и прячутся на даче. Жека рассказывает Тате всю правду и просит прощения. Позже Николай приезжает на дачу и советует Жеке сдаться, чтобы не подвергать Тату опасности.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Окно жизни
programme.desc: Славик и Надежда оказываются жертвами квартирных аферистов, поэтому после рождения второго ребёнка они вынуждены жить с семьёй Славика. Его сестра Алёна недовольна таким соседством. Славик уезжает на заработки. Пользуясь тем, что Славик в коме, Алёна выгоняет Надежду с детьми из квартиры. После длительных скитаний Надежда оставляет младенца в бэби-боксе. Соколова и Борадзе предлагают Глаше уволиться по собственному желанию. Борадзе сообщает коллективу о том, что подкидыша усыновила семья Нескоромовых. Коллектив перинатального центра прощается с Милославской - сердце коллеги остановилось. Славик выходит из комы, Алёна признается ему в своем вранье.

programme.title: Доктор Надежда
programme.desc: Главные герои – неотразимый доктор Родионов и роковая красотка Ольга Ольховская поженились и ждут ребенка, обаятельная Карина влюблена, неунывающие Вита Игоревна и Лев Борисович, как всегда, на посту, а карьерист Игорь Гордеев вынашивает очередной бизнес-план – в следующем сезоне хочет открыть многопрофильную клинику… Зрители снова встретятся с любимыми героями прошлого сезона – Александром Родионовым, Игорем Гордеевым, Кариной, Ритой Андреевной, неунывающими Квитко, а также познакомятся с новыми врачами – Надеждой Павловой, Андреем Смирновым, Алексеем Стрелецким и другими героями. Одной из основных линий нового сезона станет история нового врача клиники Надежды Павловой, талантливого хирурга с неустроенной личной жизнью. Героине предстоит пройти сложный путь, обрести уверенность в себе, раскрыть свой талант, заслужить прощение дочери и встретить настоящую любовь. Кто из наших любимых героев будет приглашен на новое место работы, а кто по-прежнему останется в клинике репродуктологии? Какое отделение больницы окажется в центре сюжета? Будем ли мы наблюдать, как молодые родители Оля и Саша наслаждаются семейной идиллией, или появление ребенка станет для них тяжелым испытанием? Да и вообще, можно ли будет вновь записаться на прием к доктору Родионову? Или властный Игорь Ильич пригласит других специалистов, и они выйдут на первый план? И кто станет настоящим мужчиной мечты прекрасной Надежды Павловой?

programme.title: Доктор Надежда

Героине предстоит пройти сложный путь, обрести уверенность в себе, раскрыть свой талант, заслужить прощение дочери и встретить настоящую любовь. Кто из наших любимых героев будет приглашен на новое место работы, а кто по-прежнему останется в клинике репродуктологии? Какое отделение больницы окажется в центре сюжета? Будем ли мы наблюдать, как молодые родители Оля и Саша наслаждаются семейной идиллией, или появление ребенка станет для них тяжелым испытанием? Да и вообще, можно ли будет вновь записаться на прием к доктору Родионову? Или властный Игорь Ильич пригласит других специалистов, и они выйдут на первый план? И кто станет настоящим мужчиной мечты прекрасной Надежды Павловой?

programme.title: Крепостная
programme.desc: Юная сирота Катерина Вербицкая — очень красивая, умная и образованная девушка. Благодаря ее крестной матери Катю воспитали как барышню благородных кровей. Она знает иностранные языки, играет на фортепиано, рисует и прекрасно понимает, что все это никак не облегчит судьбу рожденной в неволе. Катерина принадлежит самым богатым помещикам в Нежине — Червинским. Девушка существует между двумя мирами — миром крепостных и дворян. И ни в одном из них для нее нет места. Жизнь приготовила Катерине немало сюрпризов. В борьбе за свое счастье ей придется пережить смерти близких, спастись от преследований маньяка, выбраться из мира киевских борделей. И главное — победить свою хозяйку, жестокую помещицу, которая хочет убить ее. Крепостная пройдет сквозь ад и встретится с ужасными испытаниями судьбы. Что же ее ждет в конце жесткой борьбы за право быть свободной и любимой?

programme.title: Страх в твоем доме
programme.desc: Боль и страдания, которые причиняют самые близкие люди, невыносимы. Дом из крепости становится тюрьмой. И в поисках выхода людям приходится идти на самые невероятные поступки. Ни один сценарист не сможет придумать такие сюжетные ходы, которые порой закручивает сама жизнь. В социальной докудраме "Страх в твоем доме" - только реальные истории, случившиеся с реальными людьми. Мы реконструируем события, основываясь на откровенных рассказах их участников, а наши эксперты - юристы и психологи - комментируют их и помогают найти выход из сложных, порой тупиковых ситуаций.

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Out of Season
programme.desc: When a young drifter is forced to stay the winter in a small seaside town, he inadvertently becomes the catalyst for deceit, double crossings and murder amongst the locals.

programme.title: First Kill
programme.desc: Wall Street broker Will Beeman (Hayden Christensen) has been struggling with being present for his wife Laura (Megan Leonard) and son Danny (Ty Shelton). Shortly after hearing of Danny being bullied at school, Will decides to take his family to his hometown, Granville, Ohio in order to bond with Danny. Upon entering Granville, Will is reacquainted with Police Chief Marvin Howell (Bruce Willis), a family friend who at one point dated his aunt, Dottie (Deb G. Girdler). Howell advises Will on taking precaution after informing him of a recent bank robbery. While teaching Danny how to hunt with a rifle, Will and Danny witness a heated exchange between two men, one of them holding the other at gunpoint. The unarmed man (Gethin Anthony) is shot in the shoulder after throwing a key near Will's position at a shooting station, attracting the gunman's attention. The gunman opens fire on Will, prompting Will to shoot him with his hunting rifle in self-defense. Upon inspecting the gunman, discovers that the gunman was a police officer who failed to identify himself. Distraught, Will brings the wounded man to the family cabin in order for Laura, a hospital nurse, to provide first aid.

programme.title: Operation Chromite
programme.desc: In 1950, just a few months after North Korean forces have overrun most of South Korea, an American-led United Nations Command is deployed to Korea to aid the struggling South Koreans. General Douglas MacArthur devises a secret plan to attack behind enemy lines at the port city of Incheon. The risky strategy is opposed by leaders of the other military branches, forcing MacArthur to devise a clandestine operation to gather essential information from within occupied Incheon by coordinating a weeklong South Korean intelligence operation known as "X-Ray".

programme.title: Lost in Florence
programme.desc: When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police.

programme.title: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Two cop partners, who are also best friends attend a domestic disturbance, only for one to accidentaly critically wound the other. The rest of the police force are suspicious that there may have been no accident.

programme.title: McCinsey's Island
programme.desc: A former secret agent finds a treasure map and decides to find the loot. But he is not the only one.

programme.title: Irish Jam
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money?

programme.title: Almost Friends
programme.desc: Charlie, a culinary genius, has lost the motivation. He doesn't know what to with his life anymore, but he knows one thing - get close to Amber. In comparison to her boyfriend, he seems to be totally unattractive, but Charlie's closest friend convinces him that where there's a will there's a way.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: The first episode of a medical crime thriller series following a team of investigators as they uncover corruption and negligence. Dr Lucinda Edwards is a smart and experienced A and E doctor in the midst of a nightmare shift - she has a gunshot victim and an opioid overdose patient who both need a bed in resus, but there's only room for one of them. When one of the patients dies, Lucinda realises that her troubles have only just begun as she faces a probe by the Medical Investigation Unit.

programme.title: Con Man
programme.desc: The story of Barry Minkow, a young charismatic business man who becomes a wealthy CEO by lying, cheating and stealing his way to the top.

programme.title: Edith
programme.desc: After the death of his wife Edith, Jake feels like he has lost the chance to confront his past. He is convinced that Edith is haunting him for having lived a lie and for having never challenged her about the legitimacy of their son. "Edith" explores how we move on from bereavements. How we make peace with our past and find something worth living for.

programme.title: Score: A Hockey Musical
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Farley has led a sheltered life, raised on a diet of home schooling, organic living and trips to the art gallery. To his parents' dismay, Farley loves to play hockey with the local kids. To their even greater dismay, Farley is scouted and signed by the owner of a junior league team, where he becomes an instant star. But Farley discovers that stardom comes with a price - including the expectation to fight on the ice. Throw in a changing relationship with his best friend, and Farley finds himself losing his way.

programme.title: Max Cloud
programme.desc: A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

programme.title: Unknown Energies, Unidentified Emotions
programme.desc: A hybrid of animated, experimental, feature and genre film in found footage technique, with a radio phonic sound and of unexpected, almost 40-minute duration. Journalist Isidor Dukas visits the Institute for Research on Psychic Phenomena and Mental Film when a confrontation with one of the test subjects transforms a routine check into a never-ending maze. Barić's work calls into question issues surrounding artistic practices in the digital age including ideas about authenticity, simulation/replication and appropriation.

programme.title: Looks That Kill
programme.desc: Max Richards, a teenage boy born with a medical condition of being lethally attractive, who is changed forever when he meets Alex, a girl with her own bizarre ailment, who aids him on his quest of self-discovery... without accidentally killing someone.

programme.title: The Good Girl
programme.desc: A discount store clerk strikes up an affair with a stock boy who considers himself the incarnation of Holden Caulfield.Justine is a sullen 30-year-old woman stuck in a dead-end job at the Retail Rodeo department store.In addition to her mind-numbing occupation, Justine also has to contend with her dim-witted husband, Phil, and his partner, Bubba, who work as house painters when they aren't smoking pot and staring blankly at the television.Justine sees an opportunity for change, however, when she meets Holden, a fellow Retail Rodeo employee who is even more depressed than herself.The young Holden and Justine soon begin a passionate secret affair, unaware that it may not be so secret after all.

programme.title: Snowbound
programme.desc: Liz tells her old friend Barbara that she believes her ex-husband is stalking her. She plans to leave town for awhile and stay at a cabin in the mountains. Barbara invites herself along and when it seems that Dale has followed them to the cabin, Barbara discovers she doesn't know Liz as well as she thought.

programme.title: Knock Off
programme.desc: Marcus Ray (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sales representative for "V SIX" jeans, and his partner, Tommy Hendricks (Rob Schneider), are about to be busted for selling "knock off" jeans (a low-quality imitation of well-known products). Their American contact, Karen Leigh (Lela Rochon), who is not only their employer but a CIA agent sent to find the mole in their operation, is threatening them with a jail term if they do not prove their innocence.

programme.title: Knock Off
programme.desc: Marcus Ray (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sales representative for "V SIX" jeans, and his partner, Tommy Hendricks (Rob Schneider), are about to be busted for selling "knock off" jeans (a low-quality imitation of well-known products). Their American contact, Karen Leigh (Lela Rochon), who is not only their employer but a CIA agent sent to find the mole in their operation, is threatening them with a jail term if they do not prove their innocence.

programme.title: Dot.Kill
programme.desc: A detective tries to hunt down a serial killer who broadcasts his murders live on the internet.

programme.title: Fight Valley
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead after getting involved in an underground fighting ring. Her sister Windsor begins training under a respected ex-fighter as she searches for the killer.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Young Jim Hawkins and Peg-legged Long John Silver set sail for adventure in Robert Louis Stevenson's classic tale of dastardly pirates, swashbuckling heroes, buried treasure, and a young boy's courage during the adventure of a lifetime.

programme.title: Corner Office
programme.desc: Orson, a compulsive bureaucrat who discovers a secret room.

programme.title: The Sandman
programme.desc: One fine morning, Benno finds sand in his bed. While he tries to ignore this at first, he soon must realize that he himself is loosing the sand. Day after day the sand increases and soon his time literally starts running short. Finally he is left no choice but to ask Sandra for help, who runs a small coffee shop under his apartment. Although Benno hates her with a passion, he started having dreams of her every night. What could Sandra and the dreams have to do with the sand?

programme.title: Owd Bob
programme.desc: A teen orphan spends the summer on Isle of Man with estranged grandpa. Despite loving dogs, they want summer to end. Boy befriends neighbor girl, but her father has history with grandpa. Locals suspect neighbor's dog kills sheep at night.

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
programme.desc: Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood!

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: Foolproof
programme.desc: Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ambersons
programme.desc: The spoiled rotten and utterly unlikable rich kid George Amberson becomes horrified when his recently widowed mother rekindles her relationship with the wealthy Eugene Morgan, who she left decades earlier in order to marry George's father. As George struggles to sabotage his mother's new romance, he must deal with his own romantic feelings for Morgan's daughter and the consequences of his meddling as his once great family falls into ruin due to his machinations...

programme.title: Second Acts
programme.desc: When a woman reports her daughter as missing, the Blue Heelers find she has moved in with her schoolteacher.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Music critic Bob is out of a job, addicted to Zoloft, and trying to wrangle the menagerie of animals that his wife Linda has accumulated. Will adopting a baby cure their existential angst? Or should they just rescue another duck?

programme.title: Musketeers Forever
programme.desc: A group of ex-secret agents opens a Jazz Club in Las Vegas. When they discover that a local Indian reservation is being threatened by a greedy and powerful gangster, they act. All for one, and one for all!

programme.title: The Number One Girl
programme.desc: Joey is a big Hollywood action star and a martial arts champ. When he gets invited to be a celebrity judge at friend and mobster Molnar's request he falls for Molnar's Number One Girl. She is strictly off limits and so Joey must engage in a duel to the death with Molnar and his five bodyguards.

programme.title: Hangman
programme.desc: Mystery movie. American mystery, produced in 2017. Retired homicide detective Ray Archer and his partner, ex FBI agent Will Ruiney, are assigned to track down a vicious serial killer, who is playing a twisted version of the children's game 'Hangman'.

programme.title: House of 9
programme.desc: Trapped in a deserted house, nine people must play a deadly game of survival.

programme.title: House of 9
programme.desc: Trapped in a deserted house, nine people must play a deadly game of survival.

programme.title: Black Cop
programme.desc: A black police officer gets pushed to the edge after he is profiled and assaulted by the colleagues he worked side by side with, so he decides to get revenge and take his frustrations out on the community that he swore to protect.

programme.title: The Howling: Reborn
programme.desc: In the sequel to The Howling. On the eve of his high school graduation, unremarkable Will Kidman finally bonds with the girl he has long yearned for, reclusive Eliana Wynter. But he also discovers a dark secret from his past... that he is about to become a werewolf. 1 Jul 13, in an effort to fight destiny and save their love as well as their lives, they must battle not only Will's growing blood lust but an army of fearsome beasts bent on killing them... and then, us all.

programme.title: Saving Lincoln
programme.desc: Director Salvador Litvak and his writing partner, Nina Davidovich Litvak, based their screenplay on their extensive research into Lincoln's friendship with Lamon. ''Saving Lincoln'' charts their relationship from their initial meeting to Lincoln's Presidency. Lamon was a tall, boisterous Southerner who liked to drink whiskey, tell jokes and stories, play the banjo, and wrestle. Despite some pronounced differences between the two men, they shared a fondness for telling jokes and stories, and both felt slavery should be eliminated. Lamon often served as Lincoln's private confidant.

programme.title: Headwinds
programme.desc: Sarah tells Paul that she wants out of their marriage; the next day she disappears. A year later and Paul along with their children return to his childhood town to start anew after the loss of his wife and their mother.

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: A German Shepard named Rain is trained to fight in the Vietnam War and his intelligence and courage in the face of adversity wins the respect and loyalty of his platoon.

programme.title: Lost Treasure of Jesse James
programme.desc: A backwoods team of Missouri kids race to solve a 100 year old mystery and save their friends in this family friendly action adventure. Chased deep into ancient caves they must escape treasure hunters hot on their trail or be lost forever.

programme.title: Nico the Unicorn
programme.desc: A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it?

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: Donald P. Sinclair has placed six separate gold coins in different slot machines in his casino. The lucky six who find these coins discover an opportunity of a lifetime. The chance to own $2 million. Locked up in a locker in New Mexico, these six contestants must now race each other, to be the first to the cash. There are no rules in place and everything that could possibly happen, does. Whilst, behind the scenes, Sinclair's associates are placing their bets.

programme.title: Departure
programme.desc: Two broken souls meet by chance on countryside. A man and a woman, neither of them young anymore, both saddled with the great disappointments. They understand one another, even without need of many words, each providing the other with support and solace for this brief section of life's journey which they share. Cinema has taken many different roads to tell stories of despair, pain, grief and loneliness. Yet this film forges its own unique path. It leads from an abandoned carpenter's workshop via a run-down old house to a port. The pace is sedate, the whole area deserted. A bottle of schnapps, a bouquet of gladioli, a few apples and potatoes, a photograph, a suitcase and a book of Russian poems - these are the only props needed for the minimalist plot.

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: The great Wesley Snipes (Blade himself!) stars as "The Hunter" in this Mauro Borrelli (The Ghostmaker) directed film. The Recall also stars RJ Mitte (Breaking Bad), Jedidiah Goodacre (Descendants), Niko Pepaj (Awkward), Laura Maria Bilgeri (Toby Goes to Camp) and Hannah Rose May (Ballers). The movie tells the tale of five friends vacationing at a remote lake house, expecting nothing less than a good time. Unbeknownst to them, Earth is under an alien invasion and in the thralls of a mass-abduction. Director Borelli is a former collaborator of director Tim Burton and the film illustrator for blockbuster films such as Pirates of the Caribbean and Captain America. The Recall will also be shot for the new Barco Escape three-screen, panoramic theatrical format, which fully surrounds audiences and offers the ultimate immersive cinema experience. Portions of the films will also be shot in Virtual Reality.

programme.title: Living in Fear
programme.desc: A man and wife return to an old town for the reading of his father's will. It soon becomes clear that Chuck's home town is brimming with old enemies, many of whom believe his father (a priest) cheated them out of $250,000 worth of investments.

programme.title: Trigger
programme.desc: Vicki compares the new Peugeot 207 GTi against a classic Peugeot 205 GTi to see if it really does live up to the old car. Jonny road tests the new £350,000, 207mph Mercedes-Benz McLaren SLR Roadster. Tiff and Jason put the Audi R8 and the Porsche 911 Carrera 4S head-to-head. Fifth Gear meets up with Paddy McGuinness once again as he prepares for and takes his motorcycle test. Man looks at what happens when a big, 15 year old Volvo 940 estate crashes into a small, light, 3 year old Renault Modus which has a 5 star Euro NCAP safety rating.

programme.title: Weaponized
programme.desc: A damaged homicide detective (Johnny Messner) must prevent a grieving father from unleashing a "robotic virus" that he believes will destroy the terrorist cell that murdered his son, but at an unimaginable cost.

programme.title: Parim osa minust
programme.desc: Amanda ja Dawsoni vahel lõõmas koolipäevil kirglik armastus, kuid saatuse tahtel läksid nende teed lahku. 20 aastat hiljem kohtuvad nad endi jaoks väga kalli inimese matustel. Nii Amanda kui Dawson pole eluga järje peale saanud. Nad pole saavutanud seda, millest unistasid. Nüüd on neil võimalus minna uuele katsele.

programme.title: Viimane sihtmärk
programme.desc: Pärast luhtunud tööotsa leiab John Knox (Keaton), et ta palgamõrtsuka karjäär peab lõppema, ja ta asub varasid rahaks tegema. Ühel õhtul aga ilmub ta uksele võõrdunud poeg Miles (James Marsden). Verega kaetud ja vaevu rääkida suutes anub too isa, et ta aitaks tal vägivaldset kuritegu kinni mätsida. Knox näeb vaid üht väljapääsu, kuid tema plaani iga samm nõuab täpset teostust. Ta laseb sõbral Xavieril (Al Pacino) endal silma peal hoida ja alustab võidujooksu ajaga ning oma kiirelt halveneva seisundiga, kui samal ajal ka politsei juurdluses edusamme teeb.

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman

Beverly shows Ree the house and some of its treasures and gives her a peek into the life of the original owners.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives

Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. programme.desc: Hosts Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson welcome back eight former Christmas Cookie Challenge champions into the workshop to prove who is the best of the best. This time, the cookie makers are facing challenges so merrily massive, they'll be put into teams of two. First, the bakers must weave magic as they create Christmas cookie quilts. One team will have the rug pulled out from underneath them as they're eliminated, while the best quilting team gains an advantage for the next round. Then, the three remaining teams construct gigantic stadiums worthy of the finest North Pole games that also incorporate ingredients perfect for watching a snow bowl: eggnog, hot chocolate, apple cider or mulled wine. The team with the most spectacular stadium will score $10,000 and the right to lift the Best of the Best trophy.

programme.desc: Selena Gomez finds a taste of home as she tries the best Texas barbecue in Los Angeles at Moo's Craft Barbecue. Husband and wife team Andrew and Michelle Muñoz challenge Selena to create a dish that puts her own spin on their meat-centric menu. She decides to create a unique sausage containing the flavors of one her most favorite guilty pleasure foods! Selena and Raquelle quickly find themselves in over their heads as they realize that they have no idea how sausages are made. The stakes get even higher when Nana and Papa show up, two native Texans ready to see if Selena's dish can make the grade and the menu!

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: 100 Cooks
programme.desc: It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: A Game Where Children Fight
programme.desc: This investigative documentary exposes the systematic militarisation of Ukrainian children in temporarily occupied territories, where occupying forces threaten parents into sending them to Russian schools and youth organisations. Through the story of Oksana, who was deceived into attending Russia's Avangard camp, the film shows how military instructors at the Voin centre teach teenagers to operate drones and handle firearms and grenades. Journalists also identify the organisers of a system designed to prepare a new generation of Ukrainians for endless war.

programme.title: Fuhrer 2.0
programme.desc: Is history repeating itself before our eyes? A documentary examines the shocking similarities between two dictators, Adolf Hitler and Vladimir Putin. Despite a 66-year age gap, their methods are identical: from the suppression of freedoms and nationalist propaganda to bloody wars of aggression. The filmmakers explore how childhood trauma and domestic violence shaped the characters of future tyrants, and compare their military strategies—from the devastation of World War II to modern aggression in Ukraine, Georgia, and Syria. A deep psychological portrait of those who brought the world to the brink of disaster.

programme.desc: Is history repeating itself before our eyes? A documentary examines the shocking similarities between two dictators, Adolf Hitler and Vladimir Putin. programme.title: Kõrgmoe fassaad
programme.desc: Kolme naise elud ristuvad Pariisis moenädala möllu ajal. Maxine (Angelina Jolie) on Ameerika filmitegija, kes avastab, et tal on rinnavähk, ning kel tekib ootamatu side vana tuttavaga (Louis Garrel). Ada (Anyier Anei) on modellinduses uus nägu, kes põgenes kodust Lõuna-Sudaanis talle määratud saatuse eest. Ja Angèle (Ella Rumpf) on moelavade varjudes töötav meigikunstnik.

programme.title: Jääaeg: Kokkupõrge
programme.desc: USA 2016 animakomöödia Lavastaja: Mike Thurmeier ,Galen T. Chu OSades: Anu Lamp, Lembit Ulfsak, Marko Matvere, Priit Võigemast ja paljud teised. Scrati (Chris Wedge) pidevad katsed oma tammetõru kätte saada viivad selleni, et ta vallandab sündmuste laine, mille tõttu asteroidid Maa suunas tormavad. Kaos sunnib Mannyt (Ray Romano), Diegot (Denis Leary), Sidi (Ray Romano) ja nende peresid varjupaika otsima. Seiklushimuline nirk Buck (Simon Pegg) hoiatab neid, et tulemas võib olla massiline väljasuremine. Uut kodu otsides kohtuvad nad mitmete uute tegelastega ja külastavad eksootilisi paiku. Scrati lõputu jaht tabamatule tammetõrule katapulteerib ta universumisse, kus ta lükkab kogemata liikvele kosmilise sündmustejada, mis muudavad ja ähvardavad tervet Jääaja maailma. Selleks, et end päästa, lahkuvad Sid, Manny, Diego, ja ülejäänud kari oma kodust ja asuvad teekonnale täis nalja ja seiklusi, rännates uutele eksootilistele maadele ning kohates tervet hulka värvikaid tegelaskujusid.

programme.title: Mina, Supervaras 2
programme.desc: USA / Prantsusmaa / Jaapan 2013 animakomöödia EESTI KEELES! Kui endine supervaras Gru kohaneb pereeluga ning üritab moosiäriga ausalt elatist teenida, varastatakse ära salajane Arktika laboratoorium. Varastevastane Liiga otsustab, et nad vajavad asjatundja abi ning palkab sel otstarbel tõrksa Gru. Koos veidrikust Varastevastase Liiga agendi Lucy Wilde'iga jõuab Gru järeldusele, et peamine kahtlusalune on surnuks peetud supersuli El Macho, kelle teismeline poeg kõigele lisaks ta vanimale tütrele Margole külge lööb. Ilmselt olles pimestatud liigsest kaitseinstinktist oma laste suhtes ja kasvavast kiindumusest Lucysse, näib Gru olevat valel teel ka siis, kui ta käsilased vaikselt mingil õelal eesmärgil röövitakse 2 Oscari nominatsiooni! PARIM ANIMAFILM PARIM FILMILAUL Lavastaja:Chris Renaud, Pierre Coffin Osades(hääled):Tiit Sukk, Liina Vahtrik, Tarmo Männard, Margus Tabor, Ivo Uukkivi, Kadri Adamson, Mirtel Pohla jt. Dublaaži režissöör on Margo Teder.

programme.title: Kapten Saablihammas ja võluteemant
programme.desc: Džungliprints Megan Han ja Kariibi mere piraat kapten Mõõkhammas ajavad juba ammu võluteemandi jälgi, mis ei ole harilik kalliskivi. Täiskuu ajal võib see täita kõige salajasemad soovid, ükskõik milline see soov ka poleks. Džungliprints annaks ära kõik siin maailmas, et vabaneda päikesevalguse kartusest ja lõpuks džunglihämarusest välja pääseda. Kui aga teemandi leiaks mereröövel Mõõkhammas, kaunistaks ta terve oma lossi kulla ja kalliskividega - maailma kõige ilusam ja targem piraat on ju ometigi seda väärt. Aga kõik nende otsingud lähevad haledasti luhta, kui aarde leiab hoopis juhuslikult džunglis luusiv poiss Mark...

programme.title: Soovin, et sa oleksid siin
programme.desc: Neli austraallast otsustavad jätta argimured selja taha ning sõidavad spontaansele puhkusereisile Kambodžasse. Päike paistab, elu on tšill... kuni üks nende seltskonnast mõistatuslikult kaob. Abikaasad Dave ja Alice ning naise õde Stephanie naasevad koju, Stephi elukaaslane Jeremy on aga jäljetult kadunud. Süütundest vaevatud sõbrad püüavad oma eluga edasi minna, kuid päevavalgele tuleb üha rohkem paljastusi reisil juhtunust. Üks neist teab tõde sellest, mis tegelikult juhtus tol saatuslikul täiskuuööl seal Kagu-Aasia paradiisirannas.

programme.title: Vaimudest viidud
programme.desc: Kümneaastane Chihiro satub oma perega võlutud metsa, kus ta vanemad muutuvad sigadeks. Üksinda fantaasiamaailmas vanemaid otsival tüdrukul tuleb ohverdada oma nimi - tema identiteedi võti. Chihiro, uue nimega Sen, satub tööle nõid Yubaba saunamajas ja kohtub seal eriskummaliste tegelastega - väsinud vaimude ning hingedega, kes otsivad puhkust inimeste maailmast. Teeneka jaapani animafilmide lavastaja Hayao Miiyazaki joonisfilm jagas Berliini rahvusvahelisel filmifestivalil Kuldkaru koos iirlase Paul Greengrassi poliitilise draamaga "Verine pühapäev". Lisaks omamaistele auhindadele on seiklusfantaasia "Vaimudest viidud" pälvinud ka Oscari. Filmist on leitud rohkesti paralleele perefilmiga "Võlur Oz" ja Lewis Carrolli populaarse lasteraamatuga "Alice imedemaal".

programme.title: Ämblikmees: Kodust kaugel
programme.desc: Peter Parker pühib New Yorgi tuttavate tänavate tolmu jalgelt ja sõidab puhkusele Euroopasse. Ent endalegi ootamatult kujuneb puhkusest üks vägev seiklus, sest ta tõmbab jälle selga superkangelase kostüümi ja võtab koos Nick Furyga (Samuel L. Jackson) ette pöörase missiooni. Nad peavad päästma maailma kurjuse jõudude käest, mis ähvardavad laastada terve mandri. Kodust kaugel peab Peter kaitsma sõpru, päästma maailma ja leppima oma eluga Ämblikmehena. R: Jon Watts. O: Tom Holland, Samuel L. Jackson, Jake Gyllenhaal jt.

programme.title: Harold ja võlukriit
programme.desc: Kui seiklushimuline Harold midagi oma raamatus joonistab, siis see muutub ka tõeliseks. Kui ta aga suureks kasvab ja ennast oma raamatu lehekülgedelt päris maailma joonistab, siis mõistab Harold, et tal on päris elust paljugi õppida ning ta lilla võlukriit võib põhjustada palju sekeldusi. Kui aga piiritu kujutlusvõime vägi valedesse kätesse satub, on vaja kogu Haroldi ja ta sõprade loomingulisust, et päästa nii päris kui ka tema maailm.

programme.title: Taevas on päriselt olemas
programme.desc: Väikelinna isa peab leidma endas julguse ja veendumuse, et jagada oma poja erakordset ja elu muutvat kogemust maailmaga.

programme.title: Kaitse mind
programme.desc: Surmale määratud tüdruk peab ellujäämiseks võitlema ja varastama, õppides kõige hirmutavamalt mehelt, keda ta teab: oma isalt. Üheskoos peavad nad põgenema korrumpeerunud šerifi ja jõhkra jõugujuhi eest, kes ei peatu millegi ees, et kaitsta oma kriminaalseid huve.

programme.title: Kullake
programme.desc: New Yorgi edukas tegevjuht, ema ja abikaasa Romy (Nicole Kidman) elab hoolikalt kontrollitud maailmas, kus iga hetk on planeeritud ning ta on alati teadlik, kuidas ta teistele välja paistab. Siiski pole ta oma pikas abielus armastava, hooliva ja kunstile pühendunud Jacobi (Antonio Banderas) kõrval kunagi tõeliselt naudingut kogenud. Olles mõjuvõimas, ent rahuldamata, seab Romy ohtu nii oma karjääri kui ka pere, alustades tulist ja keerulist suhet endast märkimisväärselt noorema praktikandiga. See kirglik kassi ja hiire mäng, kus võimusuhted pidevalt muutuvad, viib vaataja tagasi 90ndate seksuaalse pingega laetud põnevike kuldaega. Peaosatäitja Nicole Kidman võitis rolliga Veneetsia filmifestivali parima näitlejanna auhinna.

Peaosatäitja Nicole Kidman võitis rolliga Veneetsia filmifestivali parima näitlejanna auhinna.

programme.title: Must telefon 2
programme.desc: Nelja aasta eest surmas 13-aastane Finn (Mason Thames) oma röövija ja põgenes, jäädes kurikuulsa sarimõrvari Krabaja (Ethan Hawke) ohvritest ainsaks ellujäänuks. Kuid tõeline kurjus ületab ka surma piirid... ja telefon heliseb taas. Finni nooremat õde Gweni (Madeleine McGraw) hakkavad vaevama luupainajalikud nägemused kolmest poisist, kes näivad olevat surmaohus Alpine Lake'i talvelaagris. Otsustanud lahendada müsteerium ja lõpetada nii enda kui ka venna piinad, veenab Gwen Finni laagrit külastama. Koos peavad vend ja õde seisma silmitsi tapjaga, kes on muutunud surmas võimsamaks, kui kumbki ettegi kujutada oskas.

programme.title: Canterville'i lossi vaim
programme.desc: Kummitus sir Simon de Canterville on juba 300 aastat oma lossis elanud ja talle väga meeldib seal. Sir Canterville'i lõbustab lossi vahetevahel sattuvate külaliste kiire lahkumine, kui nad teda kohtavad. Kuid ühel päeval kolib vanasse lossi Otise perekond ja see seltskond on vanale vaimule šokk! Uued lossiomanikud ei karda kummitusjutte, nad peavad neid... natuke vanamoelisteks. Ükskõik, kui õudseid lugusid Sir Canterville välja mõtleb, meeldivad need perekonnale väga. Vana kummitus tiirutab oma lossis ringi, hoides peast kinni! Kuidas on see võimalik?! Otiste vembumeestest poisid, kaksikud Kent ja Louis, hirmutavad hoopis teda ennast! Ja saadiku naine, proua Lucretia, soovitab sööril oma kolisevad ketid õlitada, sest selle müra sees on võimatu uinuda! Sir Canterville on asja pärast väga mures. Kui asjad nii jätkuvad, kaotab ta igaveseks maine kõige hirmsama kummitusena! Ootamatult aga sõbruneb Sir Canterville pere noordaami Virginia'ga. Võluv kummitus räägib talle oma uskumatu eluloo ja siis algavad tõelised seiklused, mis on täis põnevaid üllatusi.

programme.title: Kuidas taltsutada lohet
programme.desc: Karmil Berki saarel, kus viikingid ja lohed on põlvkondade vältel olnud lepitamatud vaenlased, eristub Kokutis (Mason Thames) kõigist teistest. Pealik Stoik Suure (Gerard Butler) leidlik, kuid tähelepanuta jäetud poeg sõbruneb kardetud tõugu lohega, kellel paneb nimeks Hambutu. Nende kahe vahel tekkiv side paljastab lohede tõelise olemuse, pannes sellega proovile viikingiühiskonna alustõed.

programme.title: Ämblikmees: Kodust kaugel

programme.title: Hotell Transilvaania
programme.desc: Welcome to Hotel Transylvania, Dracula's lavish five-stake resort, where monsters and their families can live it up and no humans are allowed. One special weekend, Dracula has invited all his best friends to celebrate his beloved daughter Mavis's 118th birthday. For Dracula catering to all of these legendary monsters is no problem but the party really starts when one ordinary guy stumbles into the hotel and changes everything!

programme.title: Minu naaber Totoro
programme.desc: Satsuki ja tema noorem õde Mei kolivad koos isaga linnast uude maakodusse, et elada lähemal haiglas olevale emale. Peagi avastavad tüdrukud, et vanas majas pesitseb peale nende veel keegi, kes osutuvad kummalisteks, kuid heasoovlikeks vaimudeks. Uudishimulik Mei püüab vaimude elu kohta juurde uurida ja see viib ta maja ääres kasvava suurte puude saluni ning täiskasvanute silmadele nähtamatuks jääva Totoroni, hiiglasliku metsaisandani. Ääretult sõbralik ja rahumeelne metsavaim võtab tüdrukud ruttu omaks ja viib nad vastu ootamatutele seiklustele. Jaapani animelegendi Hayao Miyazaki ("Vaimudest viidud", "Howli liikuv kindlus") neljas täispikk film võitis juba esimesel linastusnädalal nii kriitikute kui ka publiku südamed. Sageli on seda vägivallatut ja helget linateost nimetatud ka maailma parimaks koguperefilmiks, mis iial kinolinale jõudnud.

programme.title: Hotell Translvaania 3
programme.desc: Kõigi lemmikkoletiste perekond läheb luksuslikule koletiste kruiisilaevale puhkama, et Drac saaks pideva hotellikülastajate eest hoolitsemise asemel isegi suve nautida. Dracula kamp lõbutseb laevapardal - mängitakse koletiste võrkpalli, käiakse eksootilistel ekskursioonidel ja päevitatakse kuuvalgel. Kuid unelmate puhkusest saab õudusunenägu, kui Mavis taipab, et Drac on laeva salapärasesse kaptenisse Erickasse armunud. Viimasel on aga ohtlik saladus, mis võib kõik koletised maamunalt pühkida.

programme.title: Tõesta, et olen süüdi
programme.desc: 1980. aastate lõpus kaitses madala astme gangster nimega Jackie DiNorscio end kohtus Ameerika kohtuajaloo pikima kriminaalmenetluse käigus.

programme.title: Esimene oomen
programme.desc: Noor ameeriklanna saabub 70ndate alguses Rooma, et alustada elu kiriku teenistuses. Seal puutub ta aga kokku maailma ähvardava pimedusega, mis paneb teda kahtlema oma usus. Kahtlused süvenevad veelgi, kui Margaret (Nell Tiger Free) saab teada vandenõust, mille eesmärgiks näib olevat antikristuse sünd. Kriipiv õudusfilm "Esimene oomen" on eellooks 1976. aastal valminud klassikatükile "Oomen".

programme.title: Esimene oomen
programme.desc: Noor ameeriklanna saabub 70ndate alguses Rooma, et alustada elu kiriku teenistuses. Seal puutub ta aga kokku maailma ähvardava pimedusega, mis paneb teda kahtlema oma usus. Kriipiv õudusfilm "Esimene oomen" on eellooks 1976. aastal valminud klassikatükile "Oomen".

programme.title: Võimuballaad
programme.desc: Kui Rick, oma hiilgeaegu jau ületanud pulmalaulja, kohtub esinemisel hääbuva poistebändi tähe Dannyga, tekib neil muusika ja hilisõhtuse improviseerimise kaudu side. Kuid kui Danny muudab ühe Riki lauludest hitiks, mis ta karjääri taas käivitab, otsustab Rick tagasi saada tunnustuse, mida ta enda arvates väärib — isegi siis, kui see tähendab riskimist kõigega, mis talle oluline.

programme.title: Tõeline valu
programme.desc: Kahe vastuolulise karakteri, keda mängivad Kieran Culkin ja Jesse Eisenberg, kokkupõrked moodustavad selle südamliku teekonnafilmi selgroo ja ka südame. Kahe Oscari nominent, ühe võitja!

programme.title: Snoopy ja Charlie Brown: Tobukeste film
programme.desc: USA 2015 animakomöödia Lavastaja:Steve Martino Osades(hääled): Charlie võtab ette võimatuna näiva ülesande saada populaarseks ja meeldida seda tehes klassi uuele tüdrukule. Loomulikult ei saa ta seda teha ilma oma leidliku koerata, kellel endal on vaja lüüa õhulahinguid oma vihavaenlase, vilunud õhuässa Punase Paruniga.

programme.title: Mosley
programme.desc: Animaseikluse tele-esilinastus! Elasid kord torifandid, raske põllutööga kurnatud neljajalgsed, kes ei osanud unistadagi paremast elust. Kuni noor torifant nimega Mosley avastas saladuse, et nende esiisad käisid kahel jalal ning nautisid tunduvalt paremat elu kui see, millega tema vanemad ja vanavanemad päevast päeva leppima pidid. Nii asubki Mosley ohtuderikkale teekonnale, et jõuda selle saladuse juurte juurde.

programme.title: Minu naaber Totoro
programme.desc: Satsuki ja tema noorem õde Mei kolivad koos isaga linnast uude maakodusse, et elada lähemal haiglas olevale emale. Peagi avastavad tüdrukud, et vanas majas pesitseb peale nende veel keegi, kes osutuvad kummalisteks, kuid heasoovlikeks vaimudeks. programme.title: Hotell Transilvaania 2
programme.desc: Drac püüab koos koletistest sõpradega kasvatada lapselapsest tõelist vampiiri, et Mavisel ei oleks põhjust hotellist lahkuda.

programme.title: Ühe liblika lugu
programme.desc: See on südantsoojendav lugu julgest, armsast ja kohmakast ühetiivalisest teismelisest monarhliblikas Patrickust, kes rändab laevaga. Temaga kaasas on naljakas röövik Marty ja terava keelega Jennifer. Patrickust saab järsku kangelane, aga kõigepealt peab ta astuma vastu oma hirmule, võtma omaks ainulaadsuse ja võitma ebaõnne. Samal ajal peab ta võitlema elementidega, vältima kurjust ja näljaseid vareseid, kes ihkavad kättemaksu, ning hoidma ära katastroofi monarhliblikate ohtliku rände ajal.

programme.title: Hotell Translvaania 3
programme.desc: Kõigi lemmikkoletiste perekond läheb luksuslikule koletiste kruiisilaevale puhkama, et Drac saaks pideva hotellikülastajate eest hoolitsemise asemel isegi suve nautida. programme.title: Jumanji: Tere tulemast džunglisse
programme.desc: Uhiuues seikluses "Jumanji: Tere tulemast džunglisse" astuvad üles ainult staarid – Dwayne Johnson ("Rannavalve", "Kiirete ja vihaste" filmid), Jack Black ("Gulliveri reisid", "King Kong"), Kevin Hart ("Luurespetsid", "Ole tugev!") ja Karen Gillan ("Galaktika valvurid", "Galaktika valvurid Vol.2") - nelja ebatõenäolise sõbra rollis, kes kistakse Jumanji ohtlikusse maailma ja muudetakse ainulaadsete oskustega avatarideks. Neil seisab ees elu ohtlikem seiklus, või siis jäävadki nad igaveseks Jumanjisse...

programme.title: Jumanji: järgmine tase
programme.desc: Filmis "Jumanji: järgmine tase" on jõuk tagasi, kuid mäng on muutunud. Päästmaks üht endi seast, naasevad nad Jumanjisse, kus selgub, et kõik on teisiti. Maailma ohtlikemas mängus ootavad mängijaid ees tundmatud ja avastamata paigad, viljatutest kõrbetest lumiste mägedeni.

programme.title: Arkaadlane
programme.desc: Lähitulevikus on elu Maal hävinud. Paul (Nicolas Cage) elab koos oma teismeliste kaksikutega, Thomas (Jaeden Martell) ja Joseph (Maxwell Jenkins), nende päevad mööduvad rahulikult, kuid ööd on piinarikkad. Päikese loojudes ärkavad metsikud öised olendid, kes aplalt kugistavad alla kõik elusad hinged oma teel. Mehed on isa juhtimisel apokalüptilise maailma reeglitega juba harjunud, kuniks ühel päeval hakkab kõik vasakule kiskuma. Thomas ei jõua õigeks ajaks koju ning tema otsingute käigus saab isa raskelt vigastada. Nüüd jääb ellujäämine kaksikute õlgadele ja kasutusele tuleb võtta kõik teadmised, mida isa on neile õpetanud.

programme.title: Uus algus
programme.desc: USA 2013 romantiline draama Lavastaja: John Carney Osades: Keira Knightley, Mark Ruffalo, Adam Levine Mis juhtub, kui üksikud inimesed kohtuvad ja teevad koos ilusat muusikat?Gretta (Keira Knightley) ja tema kauaaegne kallim Dave (Adam Levine) on keskkoolist saati koos olnud laulukirjutajad, kes kolivad New Yorki, kui mees saab lepingu suure plaadifirmaga. Aga värske kuulsuse ahvatlused viivad Dave'i peagi õigelt teelt kõrvale ning segaduses ja armastuses pettunud Gretta jääb üksi.Tema maailm muutub paremaks, kui põlualune plaadifirma produtsent Dan (Mark Ruffalo) East Village'is tema esinemise peale satub ja on silmapilkselt tema andest lummatud. Sellest juhuslikust kohtumisest võrsub võluv portree neid mõlemaid muutvast koostööst, mille taustaks on suvi New York City's.

programme.title: Näoga mööda asfalti
programme.desc: Mida on üks mees valmis keerulisse olukorda sattudes tegema, et kanda hoolt oma perekonna eest?Selle probleemiga põrkab ühel päeval kokku karmikäeline "vana kooli" politseinik Brett Ridgeman (Mel Gibson), kes ühes oma lühikest süütenööri omava noorema paarimehe Anthony Lurasettiga (Vince Vaughn) on üht järjekordselt kahtlusalust tavapärasest veidi karmimalt kohelnud kui võib-olla viisakas oleks. Võib-olla poleks sellest muidu suurt midagi, üks inimjätis sai avansina paar võmmu, aga see kõik on toimunud uudishimuliku pealtnägija mobiiltelefoni filmimisulatuses ja peatselt on klipp sotsiaalmeedias ning õhtustes uudistes laineid löömas. Lavastaja: S.Craig Zahler Osades:Jennifer Carpenter, Mel Gibson, Vince Vaughn

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Maccabi - Dubai
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: UFC. Jiří Procházka-Navajo Stirling
programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga. Werder Bremen - Hamburg
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Valencia - Panathinaikos
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.
